notes.title: 《Cosmic Ultramarine》Update
notes.notes:
This update includes:

 1. Fixed the bug that prevented the completion of spaceship events in the "Gate" and "Information Highway" in heaven
 2. Add three new tracks and adjust the titles of some tracks
 3. Add three new topics for Rain
